::: {.cj-hero}
::: {.cj-mission}
**Conjura is a public archive of unresolved cryptography conjectures, worked on in the open: AI-assisted, formally verified where feasible, and fully transparent about how each result was produced.** The aim is for research to compound instead of collide, not to get rediscovered or re-attempted in isolated silos.

[Read more about Conjura](about/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::

Conjura collects *unresolved conjectures in cryptography*, precise write-ups that don't necessarily resolve a conjecture, book-length surveys, and the *prompts and tooling* used to work on all of it with AI assistance.
:::

## Contributing

This site is built from plain files in its [GitHub repository](https://github.com/crypto-conjura/crypto-conjura.github.io). To submit a new conjecture, paper, or prompt, open a pull request; to flag a gap in a proof or discuss a conjecture, open an issue.
